newsitem.title: CHINA: China says Three Gorges bonds get strong reception.
newsitem.headline: China says Three Gorges bonds get strong reception.

text.p: Investors in Beijing have snapped up newly issued bonds to finance the huge Three Gorges dam project, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Sunday.
It quoted CITIC Securities Co, one of the underwriters, as saying that it might opt to increase its underwriting share from the current 300 million yuan ($36.1 million).
CITIC Securities was quoted as saying it planned to market 40-50 million yuan of the bonds in the Chinese capital alone.
A total of 1.0 billion yuan ($120.48 million) of the three-year bonds is being offered to the public.

The bonds, which carry annual interest of 11 percent and are designed to help finance the huge dam on the Yangtze River, went on sale on Friday and will be offered through March 18. They will be listed on the Shanghai stock exchange.
The dam will be finished in about 20 years. Total spending on the project is expected to reach 90 billion yuan ($10.84 billion) at current prices.
